description: Returns details of Clausely's referral partner programme for accountants, consultants, HR advisers, and agencies who want to offer UK compliance documentation to their own clients. Covers how the programme works, what partners receive, and how to apply. Use this when someone wants to refer clients or members directly to Clausely. For behind-the-scenes fulfilment under the partner's own brand, use get_white_label_service instead.
name: get_partner_programme
title: Get partner programme details
